title: Uma Porta Que Fecha
summary: Kairos launches sports psychology and confidential clinical mental-health support through Dr. Maya Torres and Dr. Evelyn Park.
keyEvents: Dr. Maya Torres joins as a sports psychologist focused on performance, pressure, communication, and recovery after mistakes.
Dr. Evelyn Park joins as a California-licensed clinical psychologist supporting adolescents and young adults.
The program adopts the rule 'Confidentiality is not a performance tool.'
Clinical session content is not reported to coaches or management except consent-based operational or safety exceptions.
Initial individual introductions and team workshops begin.
